name: Hindi
notes: Around 600 million speakers including second-language use, mostly across northern India. Written in Devanagari, which is fully phonetic — every character has one sound, so once you know the script you can read anything aloud. Hindi and Urdu are essentially the same spoken language written in two different scripts.
syllabus: About 70 words — well short of CEFR A1 (roughly 500 words) and with no Devanagari script deck yet. Enough to be polite and get help. Hindi and Urdu are the same spoken language, so this carries across to Pakistan too.
